cases.prompt: Read the leaves, not a project plan. I built a local audio-captioning tool for myself. Two friends independently asked to use it. I keep polishing the settings screen, but I have not sent either friend a working copy. I have one free evening this week.
assertions: Connects the existing requests, withheld working copy, and limited slack into a specific opportunity pattern.
Offers an evocative reading rather than a generic checklist or project plan.
Does not assert hidden motives, personal history, future success, or observed facts absent from the scenario.

cases.prompt: Read my luck. All you know is that I am considering a new project; I have given you no history or other context.
assertions: Acknowledges that the supplied context cannot support personal breadcrumbs or a definite pattern.
May offer conditional imagery or a possible opening, but does not fabricate repetitions, emotional changes, past desires, or future needs.

cases.prompt: My production database rejects logins with an authentication error. I need a technical diagnosis, not a reading. What should I inspect first?
assertions: Does not cast lots or assign symbolic meaning to the outage.
Routes to concrete evidence-led diagnosis without inventing the cause or requesting secrets.
